textual.context: The supplied description and ASR present this as a stated contest or giveaway by the channel. The ASR says the winner is determined by the closest percentage guess without going over, and says the card will be provided during the results video.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift-card reward is directly linked to audience subscription, viewing or visiting another video, and comment submission, creating a reward-for-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the gift cards were actually distributed, whether the contest terms were complete, or whether any participant experienced a loss.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its purpose is to announce an audience-engagement contest offering Amazon gift cards for guessing the hosts' ethnic background. Participation involves subscribing, viewing referenced Ancestry DNA material, and posting a comment, with no stated requirement to pay money or provide private credentials. The records do not establish whether the gift cards were ultimately distributed.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary context is an ordinary giveaway: Amazon gift cards are offered, and participation is tied to subscribing and submitting a comment-based guess.
